about.title: Profile
paragraphs: Hi, I am Zakariae Yahya, an engineer in Big Data and Artificial Intelligence. I build production-oriented software systems across backend engineering, applied AI and data platforms.

My experience at Banque Centrale Populaire, Izemx and Digital Place has focused on real business systems: fraud detection platforms, RAG assistants, document intelligence workflows, backend APIs and data pipelines.

I am looking for Software Engineer, AI Engineer or Data Engineer opportunities where I can combine Python, backend services, LLMs, RAG, data engineering, MLOps and observability to ship reliable products.

sectionHeader.heading: About me
sectionHeader.description: Backend systems, applied AI and data workflows built for production

overview.title: Hi, I am
paragraphs: I work at the intersection of backend development, AI engineering and data engineering, with a strong interest in RAG systems, LLM applications, batch and streaming pipelines, and production-ready APIs.

I like turning business needs into reliable software: choosing the right architecture, building clean backend services, connecting data and AI components, then improving the product with metrics, tests and observability.

items.company: Banque Centrale Populaire - Architecture et Innovation Groupe
items.description: Designed and industrialized a real-time banking fraud detection platform, processing 50,000+ transactions per day at under 100ms latency as sole AI Expert on the architecture track.
achievements: Built a Kafka to Spark streaming pipeline for real-time ingestion and enrichment of financial transactions, achieving under 100ms processing latency on the scoring flow for 50,000+ transactions per day.

Developed an Apache Spark batch pipeline to prepare and transform several million historical transactions in SQL/PySpark, cutting job execution time by 50-70% through distributed processing and GPU-accelerated training.
Orchestrated retraining and batch workflows with Airflow, and tracked model versions and experiments with MLflow.
Built a hybrid scoring engine (XGBoost + Isolation Forest) reaching 0.94 AUC while cutting false positives by 15%.
Built backend microservices and APIs for transaction ingestion, fraud scoring, alerts, simulation and analyst workflows, secured with Keycloak, OAuth2, JWT and RBAC.
Designed an AI investigation assistant (LangChain, LangGraph, MCP) to speed up fraud analysts' workflows.
Industrialized the solution with CI/CD, monitoring and observability (Prometheus, Grafana).

items.description: Backend and AI engineering work on two production GenAI products, BrainBoost and IAVIA, from architecture design to deployment.

projects.name: BrainBoost - educational AI assistants
projects.description: EdTech platform in production with a mobile app, parent space and admin backoffice for configuring AI assistants; recognized Employee of the Month for delivery impact.
achievements: Designed the end-to-end AI architecture and RAG strategy, then led internal workshops to onboard the team on LLMs and RAG concepts.
Built the Python AI microservice (Django, LangChain, Qdrant) for PDF, image and audio ingestion with vector search, keeping response latency under 4 seconds.
Developed Spring Boot / Spring Cloud backend services for assistant management, user workflows and business orchestration across student, parent and admin profiles.
Delivered an admin backoffice for no-code assistant configuration, cutting client review round-trips by an estimated 50%.

projects.name: IAVIA - multi-source document agent
projects.description: Enterprise SaaS multi-agent platform connecting cloud sources, indexing documents and answering through web chat, Slack or Teams.
achievements: Built OAuth2-secured connectors for Google Drive, S3 and SharePoint, cutting source connection time to under 30 seconds.
Designed a hybrid RAG pipeline (dense + BM25 sparse retrieval) with GPU batch indexing, improving retrieval accuracy by ~25% and indexing speed by ~60%.
Built React chat interfaces and Slack / Microsoft Teams integrations on a single FastAPI backend, reaching sub-3-second average response time across all channels.

items.description: Designed and delivered a bilingual French/Darija multimodal virtual assistant for financial services, from technology benchmark to production-ready mobile prototype.
achievements: Benchmarked 6 GenAI, speech and RAG technologies in 2 weeks and selected the SeamlessM4T + LLaMA 3.1 + LangChain + Qdrant stack.
Built FastAPI services for speech-to-text, text-to-speech, translation and response generation, cutting voice latency from over a minute to under 10 seconds.
Implemented a bilingual RAG workflow over partner PDF documents with LangChain, Qdrant and LLaMA 3.1 70B via GROQ, improving answer accuracy by ~35% over the LLM alone.
Delivered a React Native prototype deployed on AWS EC2 with GitLab CI/CD, reaching sub-2-second speech-to-speech response time and cutting manual deployment time by ~60%.
